messages.context: Rusty 新手流程实测台词（第 1 条）
messages.raw: Hi, I'm the janitor of this mine.
messages.text: Hi, I'm the janitor of this mine.
messages.zh: 你好,我是这座矿井的清洁工。

messages.context: Rusty 新手流程实测台词（第 2 条）
messages.raw: You would not believe how many people leave ingots and stones behind them!
messages.text: You would not believe how many people leave ingots and stones behind them!
messages.zh: 你绝对想不到有多少人会把锭块和石头落在这里!

messages.context: Rusty 新手流程实测台词（第 3 条）
messages.raw: It drives me insane, but at least you unlocked §aAuto-pickup§r.
messages.text: It drives me insane, but at least you unlocked Auto-pickup.
messages.zh: 这简直让我抓狂,不过好在你已经解锁了自动拾取。

segments.text: It drives me insane, but at least you unlocked
segments.zh: 这简直让我抓狂,不过好在你已经解锁了

messages.context: Rusty 新手流程实测台词（第 4 条）
messages.raw: It makes my job a lot easier, but despite that, I still find so many items on the ground.
messages.text: It makes my job a lot easier, but despite that, I still find so many items on the ground.
messages.zh: 这让我的工作轻松了许多,可即便如此,我还是会在地上发现许多物品。

messages.context: Rusty 新手流程实测台词（第 5 条）
messages.raw: Maybe some of those items are yours? In which case I'll let you buy them back.
messages.text: Maybe some of those items are yours? In which case I'll let you buy them back.
messages.zh: 也许其中有些就是你的? 如果真是这样,我可以让你把它们买回去。

messages.context: Rusty 新手流程实测台词（第 6 条）
messages.text: You found the Lazy Miner's pickaxe!
messages.zh: 你找到了懒惰矿工的镐子!
